name: Fraud or identity theft
description: Accounts the person never opened, scam victims, compromised accounts.

name: Third-party request
description: Someone writing for the customer: a financial counsellor, solicitor, broker, executor or family member. Wins over every category except fraud.

name: Hardship request
description: Can't pay, or asks for a payment arrangement, deferral or hardship help.

name: Correction request
description: Says information about them is wrong and wants it fixed.

name: Removal request
description: Accepts the information is right but wants it taken off. Accurate information stays.

name: Complaint
description: Unhappy with how they were treated and wants it put right, when it isn't mainly one of the above. AFCA and OAIC correspondence is always a complaint.

name: Declined application
description: Asks why an application was declined.

name: General enquiry
description: A question, a request for a copy of their information, or an account update such as a new address.

name: Wrong recipient
description: Belongs with Kestrel Credit Reporting or another lender.

name: Noise
description: Auto-replies, newsletters, spam, phishing, thank-you-only replies.
